lfy792mylty8hyilrd3cvcn2.name: Café 't Mandje
lfy792mylty8hyilrd3cvcn2.line: 21. **Café 't Mandje** (Zeedijk 63; 1927) (E: "Bet van Beeren and Café 't Mandje", lfy792mylty8hyilrd3cvcn2): the original "everyone welcome" dive of the Zeedijk; also on the LGBTQ slice. Status: open.

wn0kueflexn7v9p12vr4nv0v.name: De Engelbewaarder
wn0kueflexn7v9p12vr4nv0v.line: 22. **De Engelbewaarder** (Kloveniersburgwal 59; 1971) (E: "De Engelbewaarder, the first literary café", wn0kueflexn7v9p12vr4nv0v): first literary café of the Netherlands, then Sunday jazz. Status: open.

acidtq3bomknl9gh40gu7bo8.name: Kriterion
acidtq3bomknl9gh40gu7bo8.line: 24. **Kriterion** (Roetersstraat 170; 1945) (E: "Kriterion, the cinema the resistance students built", acidtq3bomknl9gh40gu7bo8): its bar is the student-run late café; occupied by students in 1982. Evidence for the café angle: [AT5, 7 Nov 2020](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/205454/van-verzetsgroep-naar-studentenbioscoop-kriterion-bestaat-75-jaar); [Amsterdam Alternative network](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/amsterdam/recommendations). Status: open.

x1zb9tk0p5mafwrm6shd75zr.name: Café Theo Ruiter
x1zb9tk0p5mafwrm6shd75zr.line: 25. **Café Theo Ruiter** (Rozengracht 160) (E: "Café Theo Ruiter, the resistance man's literary bar", x1zb9tk0p5mafwrm6shd75zr): writers' and actors' bar until 1980; later the hipster dive Struik (closed 22 Mar 2020, [Parool](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/cafe-struik-sluit-maar-eerst-nog-een-keer-100-uur-struik~b137934c/)). Status: changed (check current tenant).

wto2stp9s00l2u87fpgh3ckl.name: Skatecafé Karin & Yvonne
wto2stp9s00l2u87fpgh3ckl.line: 26. **Skatecafé Karin & Yvonne** (Gedempt Hamerkanaal 42; 2016) (E: "Skatecafé Karin & Yvonne", wto2stp9s00l2u87fpgh3ckl): skate ramp in a bar-restaurant, late club; on Amsterdam Alternative's list. Status: open. Young, but a real subculture home.

ki3ocy9mc2qou3zeusvqwdx0.name: De Trut, the potten- en flikkerdisco in the Tetterode squat
ki3ocy9mc2qou3zeusvqwdx0.line: 1. **De Trut, the potten- en flikkerdisco in the Tetterode squat** (Bilderdijkstraat 165E, West; since 8 Dec 1985) (E: "Tetterode type foundry", ki3ocy9mc2qou3zeusvqwdx0): the squatters' disco Flux turned into a Sunday night "for dykes and fags" in 1985. It is still run by volunteers, still non-commercial, and gives its takings to LGBTQIA+ causes, 40 years on in the cellar of a squatted monument. Status: open (now calls itself a queer club). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia De Trut](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_Trut); [Parool, 20 Dec 2025, "Disco De Trut bestaat 40 jaar"](https://www.parool.nl/ps/disco-de-trut-bestaat-40-jaar-en-dit-zijn-de-queer-vrijwilligers-en-gasten-die-dat-mogelijk-maken-na-al-die-jaren-is-het-nog-steeds-een-natte-vieze-feestgrot~bb437227/); [Parool, Jun 2009, "Homoclub De Trut blijft gewoon"](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/homoclub-de-trut-blijft-gewoon~bc1bee5e/). Caveats: the existing place is the whole foundry, so the theme text should lead with De Trut. The Tetterode squat also belongs to the squats slice.

kw64ov5tb9c5ss0i2911pfne.name: Dolle Mina burns a corset at the Wilhelmina Drucker monument
kw64ov5tb9c5ss0i2911pfne.line: 3. **Dolle Mina burns a corset at the Wilhelmina Drucker monument** (Churchilllaan, Zuid; 23 Jan 1970) (E: "Wilhelmina Drucker monument, the free woman on the Churchilllaan", kw64ov5tb9c5ss0i2911pfne): in January 1970 a new action group burned a corset at the statue of the feminist "Iron Mina" and named itself after her: Dolle Mina. The statue is still there. Status: open (public statue). Evidence: [Stadsarchief Amsterdam canon, venster 42 "1970 Dolle Mina"](https://www.amsterdam.nl/stadsarchief/canon/venster/42/); [Archief Amsterdam beeldbank, photo of 23 Jan 1970](https://archief.amsterdam/beeldbank/detail/4bd00f39-a352-8862-1a8d-9cd0f600a108); [Canon van Nederland, Dolle Mina](https://www.canonvannederland.nl/nl/page/444168/dolle-mina); [Parool, 15 Aug 2026, on the monument](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/alles-aan-het-wilhelmina-drucker-monument-op-de-churchilllaan-schreeuwt-verzet~b8755332/). Caveats: dollemina.org names the storming of Nijenrode business school as the first action day. The corset burning is the Amsterdam founding image.

i49qa98lxns1x90vlsxrpmxf.name: IHLIA LGBTI Heritage at the OBA
i49qa98lxns1x90vlsxrpmxf.line: 9. **IHLIA LGBTI Heritage at the OBA** (Oosterdokskade 143, 3rd floor, Centrum; IHLIA since 1999, roots in Homodok and the Lesbisch Archief) (E: "OBA Oosterdok, the library with a free view", i49qa98lxns1x90vlsxrpmxf): Europe's largest LGBTI archive and library. It has a free exhibition floor in the public library, and its exhibitions recover places like Zuidoost's queer history. Status: open. Evidence: [nl.wikipedia IHLIA LGBTI Heritage](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/IHLIA_LGBTI_Heritage); [ihlia.nl](https://ihlia.nl/). Caveats: an institution, not a scene. Add it as an angle on the existing OBA place.

k8xtefn8yygqj0f1b8lfg1dl.name: Vrankrijk's WTF Queer Wednesday
k8xtefn8yygqj0f1b8lfg1dl.line: 10. **Vrankrijk's WTF Queer Wednesday** (Spuistraat 216, Centrum) (E: "Vrankrijk", k8xtefn8yygqj0f1b8lfg1dl): the squatted political café has run a weekly queer night with Drag Queers Amsterdam for years, with cheap vegan food. Status: open. Evidence: [vrankrijk.org, queer events](https://vrankrijk.org/events/categories/queer/); [radar.squat.net listing, Oct 2026](https://radar.squat.net/nn/node/599400). Caveats: the place belongs to the squats slice. This is a one-line queer angle for its text.

h717mexcm82kxcygf7pl8grb.name: Homomonument
h717mexcm82kxcygf7pl8grb.line: 13. **Homomonument** (Westermarkt) (E: "Homomonument, three pink triangles", h717mexcm82kxcygf7pl8grb). Status: open.

lhai68yqnit9rspzju9oq5xh.name: Saarein
lhai68yqnit9rspzju9oq5xh.line: 14. **Saarein** (Elandsstraat 119) (E: "Saarein, the café women took over (Elandsstraat 119)", lhai68yqnit9rspzju9oq5xh). Status: open. It is also a key women's-movement place (taken over by a women's collective in 1978).

izb9mb5kui93v4tgn3s4ixri.name: Odeon and DOK
izb9mb5kui93v4tgn3s4ixri.line: 15. **Odeon and DOK** (Singel 460) (E: "Odeon, from brewery to concert hall to gay disco", izb9mb5kui93v4tgn3s4ixri). Status: changed.

bw0u002t00e6kkkwmo3hrng3.name: iT
bw0u002t00e6kkkwmo3hrng3.line: 16. **iT** (Amstelstraat 24) (E: "iT, Manfred Langer's club (Amstelstraat 24)", bw0u002t00e6kkkwmo3hrng3). Status: gone. Note: a Langer biography was presented in the former Amstel Taveerne on 23 Nov 2026 (homohoreca.amsterdam news).

t8pqots0bt62opq7o8nntrq3.name: Café De la Paix, where the COC began
t8pqots0bt62opq7o8nntrq3.line: 17. **Café De la Paix, where the COC began** (Leidsestraat 67) (E: t8pqots0bt62opq7o8nntrq3). Status: changed.

vorn9yppcvh3n99sunfo4b11.name: Ons Huis, COC Amsterdam
vorn9yppcvh3n99sunfo4b11.line: 19. **Ons Huis, COC Amsterdam** (Rozenstraat 12 to 14) (E: "Ons Huis, where the classes were meant to meet", vorn9yppcvh3n99sunfo4b11). Status: open.

euwnpg1ejb39ujh9tilpeqt1.name: Reguliersdwarsstraat, the gay street
euwnpg1ejb39ujh9tilpeqt1.line: 20. **Reguliersdwarsstraat, the gay street** (E: euwnpg1ejb39ujh9tilpeqt1). Status: open.

tvpovhdjc4tusxbisgbuxkj6.name: The Amstel's gay corner
tvpovhdjc4tusxbisgbuxkj6.line: 22. **The Amstel's gay corner** (E: tvpovhdjc4tusxbisgbuxkj6). Status: open.

augj1rb6l97yt225m6nf9xqp.name: Walk of Pride
augj1rb6l97yt225m6nf9xqp.line: 26. **Walk of Pride** (Dam to Westermarkt) (E: augj1rb6l97yt225m6nf9xqp). Status: open.

tu9bo2m469n39meqc88978xo.name: Paradiso
tu9bo2m469n39meqc88978xo.line: 1. **Paradiso** (Weteringschans 6-8; 1968 to now) (E: "Paradiso, the free congregation's meeting hall", tu9bo2m469n39meqc88978xo): the mother of Amsterdam's alternative venues, opened on 30 March 1968 as the "Cosmisch Ontspanningscentrum" after hippies took over the meeting hall; revived by punk in the late 1970s (first Dutch Rock Against Racism festival, 22 Nov 1978; Dead Kennedys, Sinterklaas 1982; the Kraakkrant was printed in its cellars). Now a big mainstream pop temple, the "legend turned normie" of the brief. Status: open. Evidence: [Paradiso history](https://www.paradiso.nl/info/over-ons/paradiso-geschiedenis); [RCE post-65 heritage: Paradiso](https://www.cultureelerfgoed.nl/onderwerpen/p/post-65-erfgoed/verhalen-en-tijdlijnen/beschrijvingen-post-65-objecten/paradiso); [NPO Radio 1, Deze Dag Toen, 30 Mar 2018](https://www.nporadio1.nl/nieuws/binnenland/346235c5-045b-464e-a7f7-f8a1ffe4a1b3/deze-dag-toen-kosmisch-ontspanningscentrum-paradiso-geopend); [Ons Amsterdam, Punk in Amsterdam (deel 2), 2013](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/punk-in-amsterdam-deel-2). Caveats: existing text leads with the church; the theme-map text should lead with 1968 and punk.

cc3fb71jiphd5owntcb99vhz.name: Melkweg
cc3fb71jiphd5owntcb99vhz.line: 2. **Melkweg** (Lijnbaansgracht 234A; 1970 to now) (E: "Melkweg, the milk factory that became a 'cosmic centre'", cc3fb71jiphd5owntcb99vhz): the second hippie "cosmic centre", a summer experiment in a disused milk factory in 1970 that never left; with Paradiso and Fantasio one of the three places the Provo/hippie generation took over (Hans Plomp in Vice). Now a large mainstream venue and cinema. Status: open. Evidence: [Melkweg history](https://www.melkweg.nl/nl/over-ons/geschiedenis/); [Het Parool, Stadsgezichten: De Melkweg, 8 Jun 2012](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/stadsgezichten-de-melkweg~b590b654/); [Vice NL, De grondleggers van het Amsterdamse nachtleven..., 2017](https://www.vice.com/nl/article/de-grondleggers-van-het-amsterdamse-nachtleven-verblijven-al-decennialang-in-ruigoord/). Caveats: none.

pmt4b6bhzta5j6zk5aa44rwt.name: OCCII
pmt4b6bhzta5j6zk5aa44rwt.line: 5. **OCCII** (Amstelveenseweg 134; venue since 1992, squatted 1980s) (E: "Schinkelhaven horse tram depot (OCCII and De Binnenpret)", pmt4b6bhzta5j6zk5aa44rwt): the city's longest-running squat-born underground stage ("keeping Amsterdam weird since 1992"), named by Duivenvoorden among the squatters' big concert halls; punk, noise, experimental. Status: open. Evidence: [AT5, Poppodium OCCII bestaat 30 jaar, 1 Oct 2022](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/217065/poppodium-occii-bestaat-30-jaar-iedereen-die-hier-komt-vertrekt-flabbergasted); [OCCII](https://occii.org/); [Duivenvoorden, Een voet tussen de deur (full text)](https://archive.org/stream/een-voet-tussen-de-deur-geschiedenis-kraakbeweging/Een-voet-tussen-de-deur-Geschiedenis-van-Eric-Duivenvoorden_djvu.txt). Caveats: squat side belongs to the squats slice; one place on the map.

bey97viwn1x2hh7a7xdd6d4v.name: Club Mazzo
bey97viwn1x2hh7a7xdd6d4v.line: 7. **Club Mazzo** (Rozengracht 114; 5 Jun 1980 to 2004) (E: "Club Mazzo, behind an upholsterer's granite front (gone)", bey97viwn1x2hh7a7xdd6d4v): the new-wave, video and slide "audiovisual" club; with RoXY one of the first to play house (the Soho Connection parties of 1988). Status: gone (front remains). Evidence: [de Volkskrant, Amsterdamse club Mazzo moet weg van Rozengracht, 20 Aug 2004](https://www.volkskrant.nl/cultuur-media/amsterdamse-club-mazzo-moet-weg-van-rozengracht~b18e2d34/); [Ons Amsterdam, Hier gebeurde het... Surinamekade, 3 september 1988](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/hier-gebeurde-het-surinamekade-3-september-1988); [Mazzo Digital, Over Mazzo](https://www.mazzodigital.eu/over/). Caveats: none.

g0cd9cgj5xkql0rtu9dba7k5.name: "De Emma", Pakhuis Koningin Emma
g0cd9cgj5xkql0rtu9dba7k5.line: 10. **"De Emma", Pakhuis Koningin Emma** (Van Diemenstraat 20-200; squatted mid-1980s) (E: "Pakhuis Koningin Emma", g0cd9cgj5xkql0rtu9dba7k5): squatted warehouse with a punk stage, rehearsal rooms and restaurant; Sonic Youth played there; named with the Van Hall-hal, Vrankrijk and OCCII as the squat era's big concert halls. Status: changed (business centre). Evidence: [De Groene Amsterdammer, Woedend lawaai, 1 Mar 2012 (Terrie of The Ex)](https://www.groene.nl/artikel/woedend-lawaai); [Ons Amsterdam, Punk in Amsterdam (deel 2)](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/punk-in-amsterdam-deel-2); [Duivenvoorden full text](https://archive.org/stream/een-voet-tussen-de-deur-geschiedenis-kraakbeweging/Een-voet-tussen-de-deur-Geschiedenis-van-Eric-Duivenvoorden_djvu.txt); [Diana Ozon (weak)](http://www.diana-ozon.nl/?e=117). Caveats: exact years of the squat not found; existing text says nothing of it.

jphe2n6mbe6vwjkkd7h4kqio.name: Trouw
jphe2n6mbe6vwjkkd7h4kqio.line: 13. **Trouw** (Wibautstraat 127; 2009 to 4 Jan 2015) (E via "Wibautstraat, the newspaper street", jphe2n6mbe6vwjkkd7h4kqio): club in the old Trouw newspaper print hall, "the only Amsterdam club of world level" (Parool), a 24-hour pioneer whose closing was mourned city-wide; made by the Club 11 team. Status: gone (building redeveloped). Evidence: [Het Parool, Nog 2 weken Trouw..., 22 Dec 2014](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/nog-2-weken-trouw-de-enige-amsterdamse-club-op-wereldniveau~b283c180/); [Het Parool, Het zit wel goed met de erfenis van Trouw, 2 Jan 2016](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/het-zit-wel-goed-met-de-erfenis-van-trouw~ba8d0c75/); [Het Parool, Club 11 vindt nieuwe plek in Wibautstraat, 24 Dec 2008](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/club-11-vindt-nieuwe-plek-in-wibautstraat~b1bae374/). Caveats: list-add the Wibautstraat entry, or a separate pin at no. 127.

vyk5qo1oo3ae6j3ck6au9ipa.name: Rijkshemelvaart
vyk5qo1oo3ae6j3ck6au9ipa.line: 24. **Rijkshemelvaart** (Oude Haagseweg 58; squatted free space) (E: "Emergency waterworks of the Defence Line (Rijkshemelvaartdienst)", vyk5qo1oo3ae6j3ck6au9ipa): the squatted waterworks by the Nieuwe Meer, with its yearly Ascension Day party, DIY gigs (Sleazefest) and part of the Vrije Ruimte network. Status: open. Evidence: [3voor12 Lokaal, Achter de schermen: Sleazefest, 26 Jul 2022](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/lokaal/noord-holland/artikelen/overzicht/2022-artikelen/Achter-de-schermen--Sleazefest-); [Vice NL 2017 (lists Rijkshemelvaart among the free places)](https://www.vice.com/nl/article/de-grondleggers-van-het-amsterdamse-nachtleven-verblijven-al-decennialang-in-ruigoord/); [Amsterdam Alternative, Vrije Ruimte Festival 2022](https://www.amsterdamalternative.nl/vrij-ruimte-festival/19773/vrije-ruimte-festival-2022). Caveats: squats slice may claim it; it is the "Rijkshemelvaart" of the brief.

jsds7c6k9b08ytpixfmvm8kx.name: Westergasfabriek Gashouder
jsds7c6k9b08ytpixfmvm8kx.line: 30. **Westergasfabriek Gashouder** (Klönneplein 1; Awakenings from Easter 1997) (E: "Gashouder (Westergasfabriek)", jsds7c6k9b08ytpixfmvm8kx): the gasholder where the Awakenings techno parties began in 1997, before the Westergas became a park; techno's Amsterdam cathedral. Status: open (event hall). Evidence: [Awakenings, 1997-2001 Special](https://www.awakenings.com/en/events/2010/04/awakenings-1997-2001-special/2121/); [Awakenings Gashouder 1997](https://www.awakenings.com/en/events/1997/03/awakenings-gashouder/1921/); [DJGuide](https://www.djguide.nl/party.p/150268/awakenings-1997-2001-special). Caveats: no news source yet (organiser's own pages); Awakenings is now a commercial giant, so this is "legend gone normie".

xzfv5ja00s8lys0top4iy12n.name: Pakhuis Wilhelmina
xzfv5ja00s8lys0top4iy12n.line: 31. **Pakhuis Wilhelmina** (Veemkade 576-580; squatted 1988) (E: "Pakhuis Wilhelmina", xzfv5ja00s8lys0top4iy12n): artists' squat turned studio building whose small venue (Mezrab era) 3voor12 counted in 2004 among the city's key small stages with the Winston and OCCII. Status: open (studios). Evidence: [3voor12, 3VOOR12/Amsterdam bundelt de krachten, 22 Dec 2004](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/3voor12amsterdam-bundelt-de-krachten-in-de-hoofdstad); [Pakhuis Wilhelmina, about](https://www.pakhuiswilhelmina.nl/info/about); [Podiuminfo concert archive, Mezrab - Wilhelmina Pakhuis](https://www.podiuminfo.nl/concertarchief/podium/mezrab-wilhelmina-pakhuis/). Caveats: squats slice owns the squat story; venue years not pinned down.

qrztsoso1e5ox1zik2gbxv0g.name: De IJsbreker
qrztsoso1e5ox1zik2gbxv0g.line: 38. **De IJsbreker** (Weesperzijde 23; new-music centre 1979-2005) (E: "De IJsbreker, Weesperzijde 23", qrztsoso1e5ox1zik2gbxv0g): the pioneering home of contemporary and experimental music before the Muziekgebouw. Status: changed (café). Evidence: existing entry; [Ons Amsterdam, Vaarwel Oudeschans! (IJsbreker and Bimhuis moved together)](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/vaarwel-oudeschans). Caveats: avant-garde rather than underground; middling fit.

yyik63kl0gwzpjjww7bxymi6.name: Zorba the Buddha (Feldmann's warehouse)
yyik63kl0gwzpjjww7bxymi6.line: 40. **Zorba the Buddha (Feldmann's warehouse)** (Oudezijds Voorburgwal 216-220) (E: "Feldmann's tobacco warehouse, later the Bhagwan disco", yyik63kl0gwzpjjww7bxymi6): the Bhagwan movement's disco of the early 1980s. Status: changed (Bulldog hotel). Evidence: existing entry. Caveats: borderline on "alternative music", strong on 1980s counterculture.

jy7exiurclv6nusx4f9bu3zk.name: Tolhuistuin / Paradiso Noord
jy7exiurclv6nusx4f9bu3zk.line: 41. **Tolhuistuin / Paradiso Noord** (IJpromenade 2) (E: "Tolhuistuin and the Shell canteen", jy7exiurclv6nusx4f9bu3zk): Paradiso's northern stage in the former Shell canteen. Status: open. Evidence: existing entry. Caveats: weak on "alternative"; include only if the map wants Paradiso's offshoot.

zkgf7wnd6hdhxrwxi1b1l53y.name: Vondelbunker
zkgf7wnd6hdhxrwxi1b1l53y.line: 43. **Vondelbunker** (Vondelpark 8a) (E: "Vondelbunker: fallout shelter, beat cellar, free space", zkgf7wnd6hdhxrwxi1b1l53y): 1960s beat cellar and today's DIY gig space. Status: open. Evidence: existing entry. Caveats: squats slice owns it.

jbyuj41uiemtajl9n2l8ir0h.name: Ruigoord
jbyuj41uiemtajl9n2l8ir0h.line: 1. **Ruigoord** (Ruigoord 76; squatted 1973, still active) (E: "Ruigoord and the Sint-Gertrudiskerk", jbyuj41uiemtajl9n2l8ir0h): the oldest free space in the Netherlands, a village emptied for a port that never came, squatted by artists, home of the Landjuweel festival. Status: open; a 25-year lease with the Port and the city was signed in the village church on 17 December 2025. Evidence: [ruigoord.nl](https://ruigoord.nl/); [Rodi: Vrijhaven Ruigoord gered voor minstens 25 jaar](https://www.rodi.nl/amsterdam-nieuw-west/nieuws/477494/vrijhaven-ruigoord-is-gered-voor-minstens-25-jaar); [nl.wikipedia Ruigoord](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruigoord). Caveats: the place text predates the lease; add it. The separate "Eendenkooi Ruigoord" (tmut7ls26la7h9s6st9o85gh) is not part of this story.

q56jkyz83pqv6sj2xb83mo2e.name: ADM
q56jkyz83pqv6sj2xb83mo2e.line: 2. **ADM** (Hornweg 6, Westpoort; 1997-2019) (E: "ADM squat (gone)", q56jkyz83pqv6sj2xb83mo2e): for 21 years the country's biggest free state on an old shipyard, birthplace of Robodock. Status: gone (evicted 2019; city bought the land back in 2025). Evidence: [EenVandaag on the ADM](https://eenvandaag.avrotros.nl/artikelen/adm-van-scheepswerf-tot-de-grootste-en-oudste-vrijplaats-van-nederland-116149); [NOS: gemeente koopt haventerrein terug](https://nos.nl/artikel/2583909-gemeente-amsterdam-koopt-haventerrein-terug-voor-165-miljoen-euro); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woon-_en_werkgemeenschap_ADM). Caveats: qualifies as gone because its community lives on at item 3.

wmnu6em0co0gjbcmr8x5drj3.name: Het Groene Veld (ADM Noord)
wmnu6em0co0gjbcmr8x5drj3.line: 3. **Het Groene Veld (ADM Noord)** (Buikslotermeerdijk 95; since 2019) (E: "Het Groene Veld (ADM Noord)", wmnu6em0co0gjbcmr8x5drj3): where the ADM people went after the eviction, on old sludge fields; café, concert hall and festival. Status: open (Friday eetcafé and punk nights listed for Oct 2026). Evidence: [NH Nieuws: opnieuw dreigt ontruiming](https://www.nhnieuws.nl/nieuws/315743/opnieuw-dreigt-ontruiming-voor-voormalig-adm-krakers-maar-we-hebben-nog-hoop/); [hetgroeneveld.amsterdam](https://hetgroeneveld.amsterdam/en/event/eetcafe/2026-10-30/); [Amsterdam Alternative](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/1006/adm-noord-het-groene-veld). Caveats: lease keeps shortening; recheck outlook.

itvuljfzfp8o53797ssc5e75.name: OT301
itvuljfzfp8o53797ssc5e75.line: 4. **OT301** (Overtoom 301; squatted 1999, bought 2006) (E: "OT301 (former Film Academy)", itvuljfzfp8o53797ssc5e75): the old Film Academy, squatted by the EHBK collective, now a collectively owned centre with cinema, club and the vegan kitchen De Peper. Status: open. Evidence: [ot301.nl](https://www.ot301.nl/); [Trouw 2000, the Film Academy as "the next bolwerk"](https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/waren-de-kalenderpanden-het-laatste-krakersbolwerk~b6f7ec10/); [Amsterdam Alternative: 25 jaar OT301](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/17043/25-jaar-ot301). Caveats: AA dates EHBK from 1998, the place says 1999; the squat itself was 1999.

sa22rywq1wqxg9v6n0i8kqib.name: De Groote Keijser
sa22rywq1wqxg9v6n0i8kqib.line: 6. **De Groote Keijser** (Keizersgracht 242-252; squatted 1978, bought by the city 1980) (E: "De Groote Keijser, the squat that armed itself", sa22rywq1wqxg9v6n0i8kqib): the barricaded canal squat with its own pirate radio (De Vrije Keyser), whose purchase split the movement. Status: changed (housing). Evidence: [IISG Staatsarchief dossier](http://www.iisg.nl/staatsarchief/archieven/kraken-amsterdam/grootekeijser.php); [nl.wikipedia Krakersrellen](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krakersrellen); [nl.wikipedia Groote Keijser](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Groote_Keijser).

h5pye48czhh54i3umrxs8fa9.name: Vondelstraat 72
h5pye48czhh54i3umrxs8fa9.line: 8. **Vondelstraat 72** (Vondelstraat/Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat; Feb-Mar 1980) (E: "Vondelstraat 72 (Vondelstraat riots)", h5pye48czhh54i3umrxs8fa9): the barricaded "free state" that ended with army tanks. Status: changed (housing). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Vondelstraatrellen](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vondelstraatrellen); [isgeschiedenis: Geen woning, geen kroning](https://isgeschiedenis.nl/reportage/geen-woning-geen-kroning-de-kroningsrellen-van-1980); [en.wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vondelstraat_Riots).

e8yv8jpiop9tmx3lghuwdrgv.name: Lucky Luijk
e8yv8jpiop9tmx3lghuwdrgv.line: 9. **Lucky Luijk** (Jan Luijkenstraat 3; Oct 1982) (E: "Lucky Luijk (Jan Luijkenstraat 3)", e8yv8jpiop9tmx3lghuwdrgv): the eviction that burned a tram and brought the first emergency decree since the war. Status: changed (four flats). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Lucky Luyk](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucky_Luyk); [monument register 505807](https://monumentenregister.cultureelerfgoed.nl/monumenten/505807); [Trouw: Oude tijden leken te herleven](https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/oude-tijden-leken-te-herleven~bae1bf64/). Caveats: the Trouw piece is a later retrospective on eviction rituals; a 1982 newspaper scan via Delpher would be stronger.

w4qmushssaqhv0cwnrgdwi8l.name: Tabakspanden
w4qmushssaqhv0cwnrgdwi8l.line: 10. **Tabakspanden** (Spuistraat 219-221 and Wijdesteeg 3-7; March 1983 to 25 March 2015) (E: "The Tabakspanden, Amsterdam's longest-running squat", w4qmushssaqhv0cwnrgdwi8l): a slum landlord's empire held for 32 years. Status: changed (evicted 2015, redeveloped). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Tabakspanden](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tabakspanden); [Trouw: Ontruiming laatste kraaklocatie begonnen](https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/ontruiming-laatste-kraaklocatie-begonnen~bab4a707/); [Amsterdam op de kaart](https://amsterdamopdekaart.nl/1850-1940/Spuistraat/219-221). Caveats: the Trouw link is about a 2010 eviction day, not this one; find an AT5/Parool report of the 25 March 2015 eviction battle when drafting.

jtfibja538zai0hy5mlprl5n.name: Kraakliedenbuurt and Hans Kok
jtfibja538zai0hy5mlprl5n.line: 11. **Kraakliedenbuurt and Hans Kok** (Schaepmanstraat 59; 1980s, 1985) (E: "Kraakliedenbuurt and Hans Kok (Schaepmanstraat)", jtfibja538zai0hy5mlprl5n): 800 squatters in the Staatsliedenbuurt, and the squatter who died in a police cell. Status: changed. Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Hans Kok](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hans_Kok_(kraker)); [Ons Amsterdam: Een fijne biotoop](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/een-fijne-biotoop); [Amsterdam Alternative](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/3256/it-was-once-the-kraakliedenbuurt).

clrl0tm9f4ge90aibrn9ooc3.name: Het Lieverdje and the Spui
clrl0tm9f4ge90aibrn9ooc3.line: 12. **Het Lieverdje and the Spui** (Spui; Provo happenings 1964-1967) (E: "Het Lieverdje and the words on the Spui", clrl0tm9f4ge90aibrn9ooc3; or the cluster "Spui, where Provo was born, and its corners", l1awc3rqmfpgktsp5zqwnl18): Grootveld's Saturday-night magic happenings round the cigarette-funded statue, the birthplace of Provo and the White Bicycle Plan. Status: open (public square). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Het Lieverdje](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Het_Lieverdje); [AT5](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/226839); [De Groene: Het Magisch Centrum van de asfaltjungle](https://www.groene.nl/artikel/het-magisch-centrum-van-de-asfaltjungle). Caveats: pick one of the two places.

wiuoj22wga9vggny6injz4ws.name: Kroningsoproer: the Slag om de Blauwbrug
wiuoj22wga9vggny6injz4ws.line: 14. **Kroningsoproer: the Slag om de Blauwbrug** (Blauwbrug and Waterlooplein; 30 April 1980) (E: "Blauwbrug", wiuoj22wga9vggny6injz4ws): "Geen woning, geen kroning": the coronation-day riots, whose fiercest battle was fought at this bridge. Status: open (bridge). Evidence: [Het Parool: Geen woning, geen kroning (readers' memories, 2010)](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/geen-woning-geen-kroning~b1516ff5/); [Nationaal Archief: Kroningsrellen 1980](https://www.nationaalarchief.nl/beleven/verhalenarchief/kroningsrellen-1980); [isgeschiedenis](https://isgeschiedenis.nl/reportage/geen-woning-geen-kroning-de-kroningsrellen-van-1980). Caveats: the live Blauwbrug text is about its 1883 design and has no 1980 story; a theme-map override (or a body addition) is needed. Alternative: a separate N place "Kroningsoproer" pinned on the Waterlooplein.

gsaa5e9ntbjc4p90jq3utsc2.name: Grote Wetering squat
gsaa5e9ntbjc4p90jq3utsc2.line: 16. **Grote Wetering squat** (Weteringschans/Vijzelgracht corner; evicted Dec 1980) (E: "Grote Wetering squat, evicted with Sinterklaas on the roof (gone)", gsaa5e9ntbjc4p90jq3utsc2): two thousand police, containers on the roof, and Sinterklaas stepping out of one. Status: gone (1983 block). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grote_Wetering_(Amsterdam)); [Delpher scans already on the place](https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ddd:010621572:mpeg21:a0162). Caveats: also inside "Weteringcircuit..." (f25e8j91i9jbfbqc5mh7jl9h).

n62kgli3jrtrz1thoeji9jec.name: Politiebureau No. 14, now The Bulldog
n62kgli3jrtrz1thoeji9jec.line: 20. **Politiebureau No. 14, now The Bulldog** (Leidseplein 13-17; since 1985) (E: "Politiebureau No. 14, now The Bulldog", n62kgli3jrtrz1thoeji9jec): the coffeeshop king moving into the old police station, on April Fools' Day 1985. Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool history piece above](https://www.parool.nl/geschiedenis-van-amsterdam/in-het-pand-op-het-leidseplein-waar-de-politie-vroeger-kantoor-hield-opende-henk-the-bulldog-de-vries-zijn-coffeeshop-en-dat-was-geen-toeval~b48cf4e5/); [data.amsterdam monument](https://data.amsterdam.nl/monumenten/1c55b452-8428-41a8-bca0-0def6e8e6e3f). Caveats: legend more than underground.

w2ym89og3or6sdq4eu5thz9t.name: Damslapers and the Oranje Vrijstaat at the National Monument
w2ym89og3or6sdq4eu5thz9t.line: 21. **Damslapers and the Oranje Vrijstaat at the National Monument** (Dam; summers 1967-1970; 5 Feb 1970) (E: "National Monument on the Dam", w2ym89og3or6sdq4eu5thz9t): hundreds of hippies slept on the monument's steps until the sleeping ban of 24 August 1970 and the marines who cleared it; on the same Dam the Kabouters proclaimed their Orange Free State. Status: open. Evidence: [Historiek: Mariniers vegen de Dam schoon (1970)](https://historiek.net/damslapers-mariniers-1970-verjoegen-hippies-dam/139857/); [EenVandaag: De zomer van 1970, de Damslapers](https://eenvandaag.avrotros.nl/artikelen/de-zomer-van-1970-de-damslapers-38416); [Ons Amsterdam: Kleine mensjes met grote idealen (Oranje Vrijstaat)](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/kleine-mensjes-met-grote-idealen). Caveats: A-list place; the live body has one line on the hippies, the Kabouter proclamation is not in it.

qd0m975el7mdfp3aysy59gps.name: Vondelpark, the 1971 sleeping park
qd0m975el7mdfp3aysy59gps.line: 22. **Vondelpark, the 1971 sleeping park** (Vondelpark; summers 1971-1972) (E: "Vondelpark", qd0m975el7mdfp3aysy59gps): after the Dam ban the city made the park an official place to sleep, with a luggage depot and washrooms; up to 1,500 to 2,000 young travellers a night, world news. Status: open. Evidence: [Ons Amsterdam: Het Vondelpark, zomer 1971](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/het-vondelpark-zomer-1971); [ONH: Het Vondelpark, zomer 1971](https://onh.nl/verhaal/het-vondelpark-zomer-1971); [Geschiedenislokaal Amsterdam: Slapen in het Vondelpark](https://geschiedenislokaalamsterdam.nl/bronnen/slapen-in-het-vondelpark). Caveats: the live Vondelpark text says nothing of this; needs a theme-map override. The Blauwe Theehuis (sbbk8696zu95zuu2qvw7cd2o) has no documented hippie link I could find, so leave it out.

kf8swumgnokewmp0ugngtfdr.name: Sleep-in, St. Elisabethgesticht (Hotel Arena)
kf8swumgnokewmp0ugngtfdr.line: 23. **Sleep-in, St. Elisabethgesticht (Hotel Arena)** ('s-Gravesandestraat 51; sleep-in from 1982) (E: "St. Elisabethgesticht, now Hotel Arena", kf8swumgnokewmp0ugngtfdr): the city's budget sleep-in for young travellers in an old Catholic home. Status: changed (Hotel Arena). Evidence: [Hotel Arena: geschiedenis](https://hotelarena.nl/sint-elisabeth-geschiedenis/); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sint_Elisabeth_Gesticht). Caveats: no news source checked yet; weakest of the hippie trio.

c074zhtygclvtmgndgrfo8vx.name: Nieuw en Meer
c074zhtygclvtmgndgrfo8vx.line: 32. **Nieuw en Meer** (Oude Haagseweg 51-153; squatted 25 June 1988, bought 1991) (E: "Nieuw en Meer", c074zhtygclvtmgndgrfo8vx): Defence Line arsenal squatted the same Euro 88 day; now 100-plus studios. Status: open. Evidence: [nieuwenmeer.nl](https://nieuwenmeer.nl); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Militaire_Drinkwatervoorziening_Nieuwe_Meer). Caveats: no news link checked.

ym259a7e9z648c8ih0upgm3y.name: De Fabriek
ym259a7e9z648c8ih0upgm3y.line: 34. **De Fabriek** (Van Ostadestraat 233; squatted 1980) (E: "De Fabriek, the Telegraaf printer's works the squatters kept", ym259a7e9z648c8ih0upgm3y): saved by a 2014 court ruling. Status: open. Evidence: [Pijpkrant: De Fabriek blijft bestaan](https://pijpkrant.amsterdam/artikel/de-fabriek-blijft-bestaan-buurtfeest-op-zaterdag-5-juli-van-1400-1900-uur/); [ostade233.nl history](https://ostade233.nl/index.php/Geschiedenis).

s4bpetws8fk1izxupvq7cz9z.name: Stenen Silo (Graansilo)
s4bpetws8fk1izxupvq7cz9z.line: 35. **Stenen Silo (Graansilo)** (Silodam 100-256; squatted in the 1980s, cleared in the late 1990s) (E: "Stenen Silo (Graansilo Korthals Altes)", s4bpetws8fk1izxupvq7cz9z): the 1990s party bastion whose eviction Trouw counted among the end of an era; its artists went on to Plantage Dok. Status: changed (flats). Evidence: [Trouw 2000](https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/waren-de-kalenderpanden-het-laatste-krakersbolwerk~b6f7ec10/); [Amsterdam Alternative: Plantagedok from the Graansilo](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/venues); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stenen_Silo).

la6x4wimktx7a4og76lx156u.name: Filmhuis Cavia (Zaagmolenschool)
la6x4wimktx7a4og76lx156u.line: 36. **Filmhuis Cavia (Zaagmolenschool)** (Van Hallstraat 52; since 1983) (E: "Zaagmolenschool and Filmhuis Cavia", la6x4wimktx7a4og76lx156u): counterculture cinema founded by the squatters' movement, volunteer-run. Status: open. Evidence: [filmhuiscavia.nl](https://www.filmhuiscavia.nl); [Amsterdam Alternative](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/3256/it-was-once-the-kraakliedenbuurt).

each6n8jdf5pw2rf7mp3qklp.name: Kostgewonnen
each6n8jdf5pw2rf7mp3qklp.line: 37. **Kostgewonnen** (Derde Kostverlorenkade 34-35; squatted Sept 1993, bought 2005) (E: "Van der Palmschool and Allebéschool", each6n8jdf5pw2rf7mp3qklp): neighbours squatted the two empty schools "for the neighbourhood, by the neighbourhood": chess café, crèche, children's craft academy. Status: open. Evidence: [kostgewonnen.nl: pand](https://www.kostgewonnen.nl/pand/1-kostgewonnen); [Amsterdam Alternative](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/10860/kostgewonnen). Caveats: the live place is an architecture story with no squat line; weak on press.

lea47k92palxrneohl9e7iud.name: Het Veem
lea47k92palxrneohl9e7iud.line: 38. **Het Veem** (Van Diemenstraat 410-412; squatted 1981) (E: "Het Veem", lea47k92palxrneohl9e7iud): harbour warehouse run by its users as studios and a performance house. Status: open. Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Veem House for Performance](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veem_House_for_Performance).

nrx2dgcndexsweb2agamfjtl.name: Bajesdorp
nrx2dgcndexsweb2agamfjtl.line: 39. **Bajesdorp** (Bijdorpstraat; squatted 2003, now a cooperative) (E: "Bajeskwartier and Bajesdorp", nrx2dgcndexsweb2agamfjtl): squatters of the prison guards' houses who rebuilt as an owner co-op. Status: open. Evidence: [Amsterdam Alternative: Like squatting but different](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/9627/like-squatting-but-different-bajesdorp-continues); [bajesdorp.nl](https://bajesdorp.nl/).

gly87by1sqsojber1sut4hv1.name: De Bowling
gly87by1sqsojber1sut4hv1.line: 40. **De Bowling** (Buikslotermeerplein; squatted 2016) (E: "De Bowling, Buikslotermeerplein", gly87by1sqsojber1sut4hv1): a squat that saved Noord's "rotten tooth" for a youth centre. Status: open/changing. Evidence: [NH Nieuws](https://www.nhnieuws.nl/nieuws/358442/leegstaande-amsterdamse-bowlingbaan-wordt-jongerencentrum-safespace-voor-iedereen/); [Amsterdam Alternative](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/15985/de-bowling-how-squatting-helped-preserve-amsterdam-noord).

u0tujugichahcjrwg0ip0qf3.name: Fort van Sjakoo
u0tujugichahcjrwg0ip0qf3.line: 41. **Fort van Sjakoo** (Jodenbreestraat 24; since 1977) (E: "Fort van Sjakoo, the squatters' bookshop that bought its own building", u0tujugichahcjrwg0ip0qf3): anarchist bookshop, volunteer-run. Status: open. Evidence: [Amsterdam Alternative venues](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/venues); [opnieuw.nu](https://www.opnieuw.nu). Caveats: placed this low only because press evidence on the place is thin; the place itself is a core stop and could rank top 15.

ihp6bionlwz4429w1gxf33uo.name: De Ceuvel
ihp6bionlwz4429w1gxf33uo.line: 42. **De Ceuvel** (Korte Papaverweg 4; since 2014) (E: "De Ceuvel", ihp6bionlwz4429w1gxf33uo): houseboats on poisoned shipyard soil, an off-grid broedplaats. Status: open, leaving early 2028. Evidence: [AT5: De Ceuvel mag langer blijven](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/238540/creatieve-broedplaats-de-ceuvel-mag-opnieuw-langer-blijven-vergunning-met-jaar-verlengd); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_Ceuvel). Caveats: a tendered broedplaats, not a squat; alternative by culture, not by origin.

avb1dqu2ubtrhgalwlnhzhi1.name: Blaauwlakenblok and W139
avb1dqu2ubtrhgalwlnhzhi1.line: 43. **Blaauwlakenblok and W139** (Warmoesstraat 139; 1970s-80s) (E: "Blaauwlakenblok, the block the squatters held and the residents rebuilt", avb1dqu2ubtrhgalwlnhzhi1): squatters kept De Bijenkorf's offices out; W139 began as an artists' squat space. Status: open. Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Blaauwlakenblok](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blaauwlakenblok); [nl.wikipedia W139](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/W139).

s959q0p75l6wzbp28i0bjefh.name: Maagdenhuis
s959q0p75l6wzbp28i0bjefh.line: 44. **Maagdenhuis** (Spui 21; occupied 1969 and 2015) (E: "Maagdenhuis, the girls' orphanage the students occupied", s959q0p75l6wzbp28i0bjefh): the student occupations. Status: open (university). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maagdenhuis_(Amsterdam)). Caveats: covered by the Spui cluster too.

rx5y40sm36er28z14myelnr7.name: Robert Jasper Grootveld's floating gardens
rx5y40sm36er28z14myelnr7.line: 46. **Robert Jasper Grootveld's floating gardens** (Wittenburgervaart and the eastern islands) (E: "The floating gardens of Robert Jasper Grootveld, Wittenburgervaart", rx5y40sm36er28z14myelnr7; also "Drijvende Tuinen (Floating Gardens)", x575un3am39zfu8vbvmjvqr1): the Provo magician's last works, kept afloat by neighbours. Status: open. Evidence: [Buurtorganisatie 1018: overgedragen aan de buurt](https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2022/7/26/drijvende-tuinen-overgedragen-aan-de-buurt); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drijvende_Tuinen). Caveats: two live places for the same gardens; list one.

qqrvdnqxlfk1cilbdfbyputg.name: International Institute of Social History (Staatsarchief)
qqrvdnqxlfk1cilbdfbyputg.line: 47. **International Institute of Social History (Staatsarchief)** (Cruquiusweg 31) (E: "International Institute of Social History (IISG)", qqrvdnqxlfk1cilbdfbyputg): holds the Staatsarchief, the squatters' movement's own archive, and the Provo papers. Status: open. Evidence: [IISG history](https://iisg.amsterdam/en/about/history/detailed-history-iish); [Staatsarchief dossiers](http://www.iisg.nl/staatsarchief/archieven/kraken-amsterdam/grootekeijser.php). Caveats: the live place is about Marx and Engels; would need a theme-map line on the Staatsarchief.

nojaeehfbxwgyzpva7rjw9r7.name: KNSM island squats: "Edelweiss"
nojaeehfbxwgyzpva7rjw9r7.line: 49. **KNSM island squats: "Edelweiss"** (Levantplein 1-15; squatted 1980) (E: "Former KNSM canteen, Levantplein", nojaeehfbxwgyzpva7rjw9r7): after the shipping line left, young people and artists squatted the island's offices; the canteen on stilts was squatted as "Edelweiss" and bought for one guilder. Status: changed (live-work studios). Evidence: [StadsdorpKNSM: behouden KNSM-gebouwen](https://stadsdorpknsm.nl/geschiedenis/behouden-knsm-gebouwen-2/); [StadsdorpKNSM: geschiedenis](https://stadsdorpknsm.nl/geschiedenis/); [Museum Perron Oost exhibition PDF](https://www.museumperronoost.nl/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/KNSM-VAARDERS-KRAKERS-EN-WOONPIONIERS_-HET-OOSTELIJK-HAVENGEBIED-IN-TRANSITIE.-Tentoonstelling-Museum-Perron-Oost-september-2014-PRONKZUCHT.pdf). Caveats: the live text does not mention the squat; residents' society source is local, not press.

e5v2ottdwy5twbmpsb2fyonn.name: Villa Friekens
e5v2ottdwy5twbmpsb2fyonn.line: 50. **Villa Friekens** (Landsmeerderdijk 189-193, Kadoelen; artists' squat from 2001/2002 for 13 years) (E: "Powder-magazine guardhouse and Villa Friekens, Kadoelen", e5v2ottdwy5twbmpsb2fyonn): artists' squat in a navy powder store for 13 years. Status: gone (closed 2015). Evidence: [NL Times 2015](https://nltimes.nl/2015/08/07/amsterdam-noord-artist-squat-close-november). Caveats: weak; one news source.

d484lu482exszyh2n6r7lk46.name: Sibbelwoningen
d484lu482exszyh2n6r7lk46.line: 51. **Sibbelwoningen** (Hoogte Kadijk; 1970s-80s) (E: "Sibbelwoningen, the dyke houses saved by squatters", d484lu482exszyh2n6r7lk46): squatters and neighbours stopped demolition. Status: open (housing). Evidence: [Het Parool](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/de-gerestaureerde-sibbelpanden-stinken-al-vier-jaar-naar-rotte-vis~be272e4c/); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sibbelwoningen).

ivd4z4gbsomn71qrt431dyf7.name: Keizersgracht 318
ivd4z4gbsomn71qrt431dyf7.line: 53. **Keizersgracht 318** (squatted 2020-2025) (E: "Keizersgracht 318, the gutted rococo house", ivd4z4gbsomn71qrt431dyf7): a recent squat against a gutted listed house. Status: changed (repairs after 2025 eviction). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keizersgracht_318). Caveats: a modern-era example; keep if the map wants the post-2010 ban era.

cfvns6uzf4jwju2fmlmz42ti.name: De Roode Bioscoop
cfvns6uzf4jwju2fmlmz42ti.line: 56. **De Roode Bioscoop** (Haarlemmerplein 7; 1913) (E: "De Roode Bioscoop, the anarchists' cinema on the Haarlemmerplein", cfvns6uzf4jwju2fmlmz42ti): an anarchist's propaganda cinema, now a volunteer stage in a lease fight. Status: open. Evidence: [NH Nieuws](https://www.nhnieuws.nl/nieuws/341960/roode-bioscoop-voortbestaan-nu-huurbaas-contract-wil-opzeggen); [nl.wikipedia](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_Roode_Bioscoop). Caveats: pre-war anarchism; fits "legends" if the map goes beyond 1960.

khtnt76caaij0zkhvmztkyyo.name: KasKantine
khtnt76caaij0zkhvmztkyyo.line: 58. **KasKantine** (Handbalstraat 1; this site since 2019) (E: "De KasKantine, Handbalstraat", khtnt76caaij0zkhvmztkyyo): off-grid nomadic neighbourhood centre on temporary land. Status: open to 2031. Evidence: [Amsterdam Alternative: KasKantine 3.0](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/articles/5514/setting-up-camp-kaskantine-3-0); [kaskantine.nl](https://www.kaskantine.nl/about-us.html).

ztxusocyqxritry12i9dtpgw.name: Cotton Club
ztxusocyqxritry12i9dtpgw.line: 39. **Cotton Club** (Nieuwmarkt 5) (E: "Cotton Club, the Nieuwmarkt's Surinamese jazz café", ztxusocyqxritry12i9dtpgw): postwar jazz café where Surinamese musicians and Black GIs met. Status: open (café). Evidence: existing entry. Caveats: dive-bars slice might also list it.

vwm2d6xtbt8cuqa510ljipn4.name: Garage Notweg
vwm2d6xtbt8cuqa510ljipn4.line: 11. **QueerHub Nieuw-West in Garage Notweg** (Notweg 38, Osdorp, Nieuw-West; since 2 Oct 2025) (E: "Garage Notweg", vwm2d6xtbt8cuqa510ljipn4): the first queer living room in Nieuw-West, set up by Pink Nieuw-West in a district with a bad name for queer safety. People "can walk in without it being noticed". Status: open. Evidence: [Parool, "In Nieuw-West is nu de eerste huiskamer voor queers geopend"](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/in-nieuw-west-is-nu-de-eerste-huiskamer-voor-queers-geopend-mensen-kunnen-hier-naar-binnen-zonder-dat-het-opvalt~b61d5f55/); [Rodi, opening 2 Oct](https://www.rodi.nl/amsterdam-nieuw-west/nieuws/466353/queerhub-feestelijk-geopend); [pinknieuwwest.org/queerhub](https://www.pinknieuwwest.org/queerhub/). Caveats: very new and small. It is an angle on an existing place, not a standalone sight.

ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo.name: Kwaku
ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo.line: 28. **Kwaku** (Nelson Mandelapark, ex-Bijlmerpark; since 1983 here, founded 1975) (E: "Nelson Mandelapark and Kwaku", ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo): the Surinamese summer festival that grew from a kids' football tournament into a free music festival of 100,000+. The brief's "free festivals' homes". Status: changed (2026 was the last edition in its current form). Evidence: existing entry; [Het Parool on Kwaku (search: kwaku laatste editie 2026)](https://www.parool.nl/); to cite properly before drafting. Caveats: I did not re-verify the 2026 news myself; take from the existing entry's sources.

uj9e5r0yvdw0jjjra7e6y4lz.name: Marionettentheater
uj9e5r0yvdw0jjjra7e6y4lz.line: 48. **The map of 200 squats, Marionettentheater** (Nieuwe Jonkerstraat 8) (E: "The Marionettentheater in the old Smederij", uj9e5r0yvdw0jjjra7e6y4lz): the residents' map of more than 200 squatted addresses of the 1970s, unveiled 2025 in the old meeting place of the Nieuwmarkt fighters. Status: open. Evidence: [opnieuw.nu](https://www.opnieuw.nu). Caveats: thin sourcing; could fold into item 7.

avse5r5gizki80pu54k5gnfp.name: De Oeverlanden
avse5r5gizki80pu54k5gnfp.line: 57. **De Oeverlanden** (Nieuwe Meer north shore; 1980s) (E: "De Oeverlanden", avse5r5gizki80pu54k5gnfp): activists stopped housing and won a Supreme Court case; a wild free zone with squatter boats in its history. Status: open. Evidence: [oeverlanden.nl geschiedenis](https://oeverlanden.nl/geschiedenis/); [Rodi](https://www.rodi.nl/amsterdam-nieuw-west/nieuws/495139/brug-voor-oeverlandenman-henk-gerritsen-onthuld).

wbd77tdpthpvarbcozybilrd.name: The Empire
wbd77tdpthpvarbcozybilrd.line: 25. **The Empire, raided in 1932** (Nes 17) (E: wbd77tdpthpvarbcozybilrd). Status: gone.

dive-bars.name: Café Soundgarden
dive-bars.line: 1. **Café Soundgarden** (Marnixstraat 164-166, on the Lijnbaansgracht side; since 1993) (N): the user's named pick and the city's best-known rock dive: wooden floors, pinball, table football, Sid Vicious and Iggy Pop on the walls, a canalside terrace, and a house cat (Dexter) that has its own Parool write-up. Anthony Bourdain drank here for "The Layover". Owner Maarten Luijendijk told Parool in 2023 the café turned thirty that year; Parool calls it a café with "a raw, alternative edge" that "bravely resists" like Asterix's village. Status: open. Evidence: [Parool, Maarten & Mayke, 25 Apr 2023 ("Dit jaar bestaat mijn café, Sound Garden, dertig jaar")](https://www.parool.nl/ps/maarten-mayke-dat-rauwe-randje-zie-je-nauwelijks-nog-in-amsterdamse-kroegen~b018b73d/); [Parool, bierterrassen, 31 Aug 2018 (Asterix quote)](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/de-fijnste-bierterrassen-in-de-binnenstad~b4ac2c63/); [Parool, 24 x terrassen aan het water, 2025 ("lekker rauwe, alternatieve rand")](https://www.parool.nl/uit-in-amsterdam/24-x-leuke-terrassen-aan-het-water-in-het-centrum-van-amsterdam~b2a064f8/); [De Westkrant, 1 Aug 2026 (heavy metal, Free Palestine murals)](https://www.dewestkrant.nl/vinyl-rocks-biedt-beats-bier-en-brazilian-bites/); [cafesoundgarden.nl](https://www.cafesoundgarden.nl/). Caveats: spelled both "Soundgarden" and "Sound Garden"; the 1993 date rests on the owner's own words in Parool; Bourdain link from travel blogs only (fine as colour, not as a headline fact).

dive-bars.name: Maloe Melo
dive-bars.line: 2. **Maloe Melo** (Lijnbaansgracht 163; music café since c. 1980, Jur Scherpenzeel's since 1984) (N): the oldest blues and rock café in Amsterdam, a tiny back-room stage where De Dijk and The Fatal Flowers started and where touring acts (Dire Straits, Jeff Healey, Patti Smith, Chet Baker, Herman Brood) came after their big-hall shows. Cheapest beer in the centre, musicians' living room, nearly lost its live licence over noise in 1988 and was saved by a regulars' crowdfund in 2021. Status: open; Babel (May 2026) reports the 83-year-old owner is expected to hand over soon. Evidence: [AT5, 1 May 2021](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/208754/stamgasten-helpen-bluesbar-maloe-melo-er-zijn-mensen-die-wel-duizend-euro-doneerden); [Parool, 28 Jan 2023 (took over the café, existing since 1980, in 1984)](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/kroegbaas-van-maloe-melo-viert-80ste-verjaardag-met-festival-in-paradiso-twintigers-zijn-gek-op-die-oude-shit-van-ons~b245e3da/); [Babel Magazine, 25 May 2026 (uses Parool and AD archive)](https://babelmagazine.nl/2026/05/25/de-op-onder-en-overgang-van-maloe-melo/). Caveats: the famous-guest list differs per source; use only "Dire Straits" etc. as "according to AT5/Babel". Watch for an ownership change.

dive-bars.name: Café De Duivel
dive-bars.line: 3. **Café De Duivel** (Reguliersdwarsstraat 87; since 1992) (N): Daniël Eeuwens's "small dark hole" that became the hip-hop embassy of the Netherlands: only hip-hop, soul and funk on the speakers, the meeting place of Dutch rap since the 1990s. Survived a 2011 shooting and a mayoral closure. Status: open. Evidence: [Parool, 28 Jun 2020 "Hoe De Duivel uitgroeide tot hét hiphopcafé van de stad: dit moet een monument worden"](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/hoe-de-duivel-uitgroeide-tot-het-hiphopcafe-van-de-stad-dit-moet-een-monument-worden~b77f171d/); [Parool, Vijftig jaar hiphop, 10 Aug 2023](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/vijftig-jaar-hiphop-het-is-een-state-of-mind-en-als-je-het-leeft-deel-je-het~bb21da36/); [Parool, 23 Dec 2011 (closed after shooting)](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/cafe-de-duivel-gesloten-om-wapenincident~b08a5eb6/). Caveats: it is in the Reguliersdwarsstraat, the gay street (E: "Reguliersdwarsstraat, the gay street", euwnpg1ejb39ujh9tilpeqt1); keep them as separate places. Lead with the music, mention the shooting at most in passing.

dive-bars.name: Molli (Molli Chaoot)
dive-bars.line: 4. **Molli (Molli Chaoot)** (Van Ostadestraat 55, De Pijp; since 1979) (N): the oldest (ex-)squatted bar in the city, a legalised squat café run by a volunteer collective: vegan Tuesday dinners, squatting-advice hour, acoustic bands, chess, benefit nights, feminist and queer nights. Somewhere between a living room, a pub and a political centre. Status: open (per Amsterdam Alternative listing; confirm). Evidence: [Amsterdam Alternative network listing](https://amsterdamalternative.nl/network/20465/molli-chaoot); [GoFundMe from the collective (pandemic, closed since March, refused aid as an "ideological organisation")](https://www.gofundme.com/f/molli). Caveats: no news or archive source found yet (Parool/AT5 search empty); 1979 is the collective's own claim. Overlaps the `squats-freezones` slice: decide which slice owns it. Needs one independent source (try Staatsarchief / Pijpkrant) before drafting.

dive-bars.name: Korsakoff
dive-bars.line: 5. **Korsakoff** (Lijnbaansgracht 161; 1988 to 2013) (N): the legendary alternative night bar of the Leidseplein back side, where goths, metalheads, punks and ravers shared "keiharde gitaarmuziek als trance" until 7 a.m. "Known to all of alternative Amsterdam" (AT5). Killed by the 2008 smoking ban and the crisis. Status: gone (Israeli restaurant Mesiba since 2022). Evidence: [AT5, 18 Aug 2013 "Korsakoff sluit na 25 jaar de deuren"](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/109062/korsakoff-sluit-na-25-jaar-de-deuren); [Parool, 24 Dec 2012](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/korsakoff-redt-het-niet-meer~b16a9748/); [Volkskrant, 3 Feb 2001 (closed for fire safety)](https://www.volkskrant.nl/voorpagina/amsterdam-sluit-cafe-korsakoff-om-brandgevaar~b75873a3/); [Amsterdam op de kaart (building history: Boddy's Music Inn 1973, Stip, Korsakoff, Mesiba)](https://amsterdamopdekaart.nl/1850-1940/Lijnbaansgracht/161-165); [Archief Amsterdam beeldbank photo ("vermoedelijk een kraakcafé")](https://archief.amsterdam/beeldbank/detail/caa263be-886a-5b81-62ca-6b53dde838a7). Caveats: gone, so it fits only as a legend; nothing marks the site. A separate "Korsakoff Amsterdam" metal bar site claims 2004 to 2014 at the same address: conflicting, needs sorting before use. Strong pair with Maloe Melo next door (one entry "Lijnbaansgracht music cafés"?).

dive-bars.name: Cruise Inn
dive-bars.line: 6. **Cruise Inn** (now Zuiderzeeweg 6B, Zeeburgereiland; since Dec 1982) (N): Europe's oldest rock 'n' roll club, a self-built wooden clubhouse of the rockabilly gang The Bopcats, first on the Zeeburgerdijk in an old church-disco shed, from 1999 at Zuiderzeeweg 29 (they demolished their own building with a party), and since 21 Nov 2026 in a new home. Jukebox, quiffs, dance lessons, band nights. Status: open (just moved, "Cruise Inn 3.0"). Evidence: [Parool, 18 Nov 2026 "Europa's oudste rock-'n-rollclub naar nieuwe locatie Zeeburgereiland"](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/europa-s-oudste-rock-n-rollclub-naar-nieuwe-locatie-zeeburgereiland-na-zaterdag-ruikt-het-hier-weer-gewoon-als-de-cruise-inn~bdd970f14/); [Parool, 18 Nov 2023 "kloppend hart van de rock-'n-roll"](https://www.parool.nl/ps/cruise-inn-kloppend-hart-van-de-rock-n-roll-moet-plaatsmaken-voor-nieuwbouw-wij-zijn-de-laatste-club-in-europa-die-trouw-is-aan-een-tijdperk~b7649504/); [cruise-inn.nl history](https://www.cruise-inn.nl/98ee9-about/). Caveats: "Europe's oldest" is Parool's headline phrasing; new address only a week old, verify coordinates.

dive-bars.name: Café Eijlders
dive-bars.line: 7. **Café Eijlders** (Korte Leidsedwarsstraat 47; since Dec 1940) (N): opened in the first winter of the occupation and became the refuge of artists who refused to join the Nazi Kultuurkamer (Aafjes, Hoornik, Koos Schuur) and of banned student clubs; after 1945 the stamcafé of the Vijftigers (Campert, Lucebert, Vinkenoog, Bernlef, Ramses Shaffy). Still shows art and hosts poetry. Status: open. Evidence: [Ons Amsterdam, "Café Eijlders is al 80 jaar een artistieke huiskamer"](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/cafe-eijlders-is-al-80-jaar-een-artistieke-huiskamer); [Volkskrant, 18 Oct 2011 "Epicentrum Leidseplein" (stamcafé of the Vijftigers)](https://www.volkskrant.nl/nieuws-achtergrond/epicentrum-leidseplein~b461e51c/); [Parool, 15 Mar 2023](https://www.parool.nl/uit-in-amsterdam/5-cafes-met-kunst-aan-de-muur-in-amsterdam~b98368a4f/); [cafeeijlders.com history](https://www.cafeeijlders.com/geschiedenis-cafe-eijlders). Caveats: Kultuurkamer framing comes from the café's own history; Ons Amsterdam confirms the artists' founding.

dive-bars.name: Café De Zwart
dive-bars.line: 8. **Café De Zwart** (Spuistraat 334; since 1921) (N): the newspaper-and-writers' café of the old Nieuwezijds press quarter, with its "moppertafel"; in the 1980s and 1990s the leading writers' café (A.F.Th. van der Heijden and others). Status: open. Evidence: [Ons Amsterdam, "Het schrijverscafé: Café de Zwart bestaat een eeuw"](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/het-schrijverscafe-cafe-de-zwart-bestaat-een-eeuw); [NH Nieuws, 22 Nov 2022](https://www.nhnieuws.nl/nieuws/311322/cafe-de-zwart-viert-honderdjarig-bestaan-het-is-thuiskomen); [Parool, 21 Nov 2022](https://www.parool.nl/ps/100-jaar-nederlandse-schrijvers-aan-de-moppertafel-cafes-als-de-zwart-zijn-belangrijk-voor-de-samenleving~bc977dfad/). Caveats: Parool itself says it is "long no longer a writers' café". Could pair with Scheltema (no. 10) as one "press quarter cafés" entry.

dive-bars.name: The Minds
dive-bars.line: 11. **The Minds** (Spuistraat 245; since 1984 per the bar) (N): self-styled "the only real punk bar left in Amsterdam", a gritty dive among the Spuistraat squats, cheap beer, punk records, small underground gigs (e.g. Konijnedag fest). Status: open. Evidence: [Lonely Planet listing ("hard-core but friendly punk bar", the city's last)](https://www-lonelyplanet-com-57e2.imagizer.com/the-netherlands/amsterdam/medieval-centre-and-red-light-district/nightlife/cafe-the-minds/a/poi-dri/1097240/1323036); [official Facebook ("Located in Amsterdam since 1984")](https://www.facebook.com/mindsamsterdam/); [theminds.nl (certificate expired at time of check)](https://theminds.nl/). Caveats: weak: no news or archive source found; 1984 only from the bar itself. Scene-wise it belongs here, but needs one Parool/AT5/Vice hit before drafting.

dive-bars.name: Rock Club The Cave
dive-bars.line: 12. **Rock Club The Cave** (Prinsengracht 472, basement; since c. 1995) (N): the basement home of rock and metal in the centre, bar every day and bands at weekends; a 2020 "Save The Cave" campaign by musicians. Status: open. Evidence: [Parool, 2 Oct 2020 "Save The Cave" (25 years)](https://www.parool.nl/ps/save-the-cave-rockclub-the-cave-mag-niet-verdwijnen~b55e16b0/); [thecaveamsterdam.nl](https://www.thecaveamsterdam.nl/); [Rock Bar Legends guide, Sep 2026](https://rockbarlegends.com/guides/amsterdam-rock-bars). Caveats: start year derived from "25 years in 2020".

dive-bars.name: Jazz Café Alto
dive-bars.line: 17. **Jazz Café Alto** (Korte Leidsedwarsstraat 115; live jazz "every day since 1953" per the café) (N): a narrow pijpenla with live jazz and blues every night until late, long Hans Dulfer's regular stage. Status: open. Evidence: [Parool, 22 Aug 2025 "9 x jazz in Amsterdam" ("al sinds 1953")](https://www.parool.nl/uit-in-amsterdam/van-pianobars-tot-relaxte-sessies-op-zondagmiddag-9-x-jazz-in-amsterdam~b7dead4e/); [jazz-cafe-alto.nl](https://www.jazz-cafe-alto.nl/home/). Caveats: the 1953 date is the café's own; Dulfer link from memory and listings, verify. Could go to `music-clubs` instead.

lgbtq-women.name: Vrouwenhuis, the women's house
lgbtq-women.line: 2. **Vrouwenhuis, the women's house** (Nieuwe Herengracht 95, Centrum; 1973 to 2014) (N): on 6 June 1973 the Vrouwen Krakerscollectief squatted a former drawing school as the country's first women's house, and other cities copied it. Dolle Mina, the feminist publisher De Bonte Was, the film collective Cinemien, the Vrouwenkrant and the lesbian group Paarse September all had a home here. Men were not let in until 1991 (they got their own toilet in 1998). It was renamed Akantes in 2003 and went bankrupt in 2014. Status: changed (the city owns the building and has offered it for sale; current use not verified). Evidence: [Atria, Archief Vrouwenhuis Amsterdam](https://collectie.atria.nl/archives/item/440606-archief-vrouwenhuis-amsterdam); [Atria, "Collectief verheugen" (2024)](https://atria.nl/nl/kennis/artikelen/herstory-collectief-verheugen); [nl.wikipedia Vrouwenhuis (Amsterdam)](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vrouwenhuis_(Amsterdam)) (cites Trouw); [NIW, on the sale of no. 95](https://niw.nl/joods-erfgoed-te-koop-en-niemand-weet-het-555/). Caveats: the building is a national monument and has a Jewish past (it was the Centraal Diamant Handelsbond), which may overlap with the Jewish Heritage map.

lgbtq-women.name: Frans Wong's abortion clinic
lgbtq-women.line: 4. **Frans Wong's abortion clinic** (Oosterpark 59, Oost; 1970/71 to after 2012) (N): while abortion was still illegal, the doctor Frans Wong opened one of the first Dutch abortion clinics in a doctor's house on the Oosterpark. Women came from all over Europe, and his family received threats. In 2012 the national provider CASA took it over. It is a house again now. Status: changed (a residence). Evidence: [Parool, 4 Apr 2026, "De abortuskliniek van ... Frans Wong aan het Oosterpark was de eerste van Nederland"](https://www.parool.nl/geschiedenis-van-amsterdam/de-abortuskliniek-van-arts-en-cowboy-distingue-frans-wong-aan-het-oosterpark-was-de-eerste-van-nederland~b65ad594/); [Parool, "In dit woonhuis aan het Oosterpark zat ooit een van de eerste abortusklinieken"](https://www.parool.nl/geschiedenis-van-amsterdam/in-dit-woonhuis-aan-het-oosterpark-zat-ooit-een-van-de-eerste-abortusklinieken-van-nederland~beb6de32/); [Historisch Nieuwsblad, 2000](https://www.historischnieuwsblad.nl/frans-wong-oprichter-van-de-eerste-abortuskliniek/); [nl.wikipedia Frans Wong](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frans_Wong). Caveats: sources give 1970 or 1971 as the opening year, and "the first" or "one of the first". The clinic was run by a man, so the text should say how it fits the women's story (Dolle Mina's "baas in eigen buik").

lgbtq-women.name: Xantippe, the first women's bookshop
lgbtq-women.line: 5. **Xantippe, the first women's bookshop** (Westerstraat 193 from 1976, Prinsengracht 290 from 1980 to 1 June 2026; Centrum) (N): six friends from the women's movement founded it in 1976 as Amsterdam's first women's bookshop. It moved to the Prinsengracht in 1980 and later became Xantippe Unlimited, a general literary shop. It closed in June 2026 after 46 years on the canal. Status: gone (closed 2026). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Xantippe (boekhandel)](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xantippe_(boekhandel)); [Parool, 11 Apr 2026](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/historische-boekwinkel-xantippe-verdwijnt-uit-centrum-we-zijn-een-etalage-geworden~b0ef6519/); [Boekblad, 7 Apr 2026](https://boekblad.nl/Nieuws/Item/xantippe-unlimited-amsterdam-stopt-per-1-juni). Caveats: closed and nothing marks the shop, so this is weak under the "gone" rule. It could be told as a line in the Vrouwenhuis text instead.

lgbtq-women.name: Club RAUM
lgbtq-women.line: 6. **Club RAUM** (Basisweg, Sloterdijk, Westpoort; since 19 Apr 2024) (N): a queer-run techno club in a former bookbindery by Sloterdijk station, grown out of the SPIELRAUM parties. It waited months for permits from Nieuw-West, and it shows where queer nightlife went once the centre got too expensive. Status: open (five-year permit). Evidence: [AT5, "Queerclub Raum krijgt toch vergunningen"](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/225836/queerclub-raum-krijgt-toch-vergunningen-en-opent-half-april); [Parool, 27 Mar 2024](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/club-raum-kan-open-na-maandenlange-strijd-zijn-vergunningen-voor-queerclub-eindelijk-binnen~bd04a5f3/); [Parool, 4 Oct 2023](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/nieuwe-queerclub-club-raum-mag-dit-weekend-nog-niet-open-we-zijn-er-kapot-van~b1d76d6e/). Caveats: young, and the permit is temporary. Coordinate with music-clubs.

lgbtq-women.name: Bar Buka
lgbtq-women.line: 7. **Bar Buka** (Albert Cuypstraat 124, De Pijp, Zuid; since 1 Mar 2019) (N): opened after Vivelavie closed, when Saarein was the city's only women's café left. It is a bar first for women who love women (Buka is Indonesian for "open"), and one of the few lesbian bars outside the old centre. Status: open. Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Bar Buka](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bar_Buka); [Parool, 11 Apr 2024, "Waar zijn de vrouwencafés in Amsterdam?"](https://www.parool.nl/ps/waar-zijn-de-vrouwencafes-in-amsterdam-ze-zijn-er-nog-en-blijven-nodig-maar-de-tendens-is-die-van-tijdelijke-feestconcepten-ook-binnen-de-queer-scene~be261edf/) (snippet only); [homohoreca.amsterdam, elders](https://www.homohoreca.amsterdam/elders.php). Caveats: young and commercial. It is included as the successor to Vivelavie and Saarein.

lgbtq-women.name: Krukrecht: women occupy Café Mulder
lgbtq-women.line: 8. **Krukrecht: women occupy Café Mulder** (Weteringschans 163, Centrum/Zuid border; 13 Apr 1973) (N): Café Mulder would not let a woman sit alone at the bar, because she might be taken for a hostess. A handful of women occupied the bar under a banner demanding "krukrecht" (the right to a bar stool), and the café gave in. It still pours, a café since 1920. Status: open. Evidence: [Vrouwen nu voor later, "Krukrecht 1973"](https://www.vrouwennuvoorlater.nl/krukrecht1973/) (credits a Nationaal Archief photo); [Amsterdams Verleden post with the 1973 photo by H. Peters](https://www.instagram.com/p/DIYj9SUIdby/); [Café Mulder, own site](https://www.cafemulder.eu). Caveats: weak. These are a volunteer archive and a history account, so the Anefo photo record should be found at the Nationaal Archief before drafting.

lgbtq-women.name: Lellebel
lgbtq-women.line: 27. **Lellebel** (Utrechtsestraat 4; 1990s, reopened 2021) (N): the country's only drag show bar, founded by the drag artist Hans Wijtenburg as a multicultural transgender bar. It was saved during the pandemic and is now "a trans-alt-indie-grunge-rock queer bar". Status: open. Evidence: [VICE NL](https://www.vice.com/nl/article/dragshowbar-de-lellebel-overge/); [transarchief.nl, history of Café Lellebel](https://transarchief.nl/); [homohoreca.amsterdam, reopening](https://www.homohoreca.amsterdam/nieuws/dragshowbar-de-lellebel-heropend.php). Caveats: founding year not pinned (sources point to the 1990s). The only trans-led place with a history found in this slice.

lgbtq-women.name: Kerkstraat, the leather and fetish street
lgbtq-women.line: 28. **Kerkstraat, the leather and fetish street** (Kerkstraat 23 to 60) (N): from the 1960s a gay street, between DOK and De Schakel. Homolulu (Kerkstraat 23, 1975 to 1997) was where lesbians could dance, and the Thermos night sauna was at no. 60. Club Church (Kerkstraat 52, since 2008) is a fetish and cruise club still open. Status: open. Evidence: [NRC, 6 Jun 2018, "Tien jaar diensten in de fetisjkerk"](https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2018/06/06/tien-jaar-diensten-in-de-fetisjkerk-a1605671); [IHLIA With Pride, Güner Kuban (Homolulu)](https://withpride.ihlia.nl/story/guner-kuban/); [homohoreca.amsterdam, Kerkstraat](https://www.homohoreca.amsterdam/kerkstraat.php). Caveats: best as one street place like the Reguliersdwarsstraat. It is mostly nightlife for men.

lgbtq-women.name: Tabu, the first women-only café
lgbtq-women.line: 30. **Tabu, the first women-only café** (Leidsekruisstraat 19; 1969 to 1979) (N): you rang the bell to be let in. Status: gone. Evidence: [homohoreca.amsterdam, history](https://www.homohoreca.amsterdam/elders.php); historypin tag "tabu". Caveats: weak (hobby site only). Find IHLIA or Parool support before drafting, or fold it into Saarein.

lgbtq-women.name: Hartjesdag on the Zeedijk
lgbtq-women.line: 31. **Hartjesdag on the Zeedijk** (Zeedijk, mid-August; revived 1997) (N): an old Amsterdam street festival where men dressed as women and women as men, revived by the Zeedijk's businesses. Today it is a queer-friendly drag parade past 't Mandje. Status: open (annual, with gaps in 2013 and 2014). Evidence: [nl.wikipedia Hartjesdag](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hartjesdag); [Gay News, 25 years](https://www.gaynews.nl/artikel/7577/Van-Hertendag-tot-Hartendag-tot-Hartjesdag--jubileum-25-jaar-Hartjesdagen-Zeedijk/); [hartjesdagen.nl history](https://www.hartjesdagen.nl/geschiedenis/). Caveats: an event, not a place. It could be a line in 't Mandje's text.

music-clubs.name: RoXY
music-clubs.line: 3. **RoXY** (Singel 465-467; Aug 1987 to 21 Jun 1999) (N): the club where house broke through in the Netherlands (Eddy de Clercq and Joost van Bellen, Acid Heaven 1988), a haven for drag, queer and art crowds (Hard gay Wednesdays from 1992, Pussy Lounge from 1995, Love Balls for the Aidsfonds); burned down during the wake of co-founder Peter Giele when fireworks were let off inside. Now a Patagonia shop (2024) in the rebuilt shell. Status: gone (now a shop). Evidence: [Stadsarchief, RoXY. Een paradijselijk toevluchtsoord](https://www.amsterdam.nl/stadsarchief/stukken/uitgaan/roxy/); [Het Parool, Laatste avond van roemruchte RoXY te horen..., 21 Jun 2024](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/laatste-avond-van-roemruchte-roxy-te-horen-dankzij-gevonden-geluidsopname-het-is-pijnlijk-maar-we-moeten-het-niet-vergeten~bd85c1a2/); [Het Parool review of the Stadsarchief RoXY show, 13 Oct 2023](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/recensie-in-het-stadsarchief-komt-de-roxy-tot-leven-de-discotheek-voor-iedereen-die-afweek-van-de-norm~b3ff79c2/); [VPRO Vrije Geluiden, Acid Heaven](https://www.vpro.nl/vrije-geluiden/artikelen/acid-heaven); [FashionNetwork, Patagonia in the former RoXY, Apr 2024](https://ww.fashionnetwork.com/news/In-amsterdam-patagonia-revisits-the-former-roxy-club-a-temple-to-techno,1624863.html). Caveats: Ons Amsterdam (2008) places RoXY "in de Kalverstraat", every other source says Singel 465-467; use the Singel. Pairs with (E) "The Giele Skull and the Paradiso field, Zorgvlied", r54hqrxogjroogns9dv1h5ir (Giele's grave).

music-clubs.name: The first Bimhuis, Oudeschans 73-77
music-clubs.line: 6. **The first Bimhuis, Oudeschans 73-77** (1 Oct 1974 to Feb 2005) (N; the present Bimhuis is E: "Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ and the Bimhuis", bl7qb8jvn5x9g1oa2xh1bwh5): musicians of the improvised-music union BIM stripped an empty furniture showroom to bare concrete and built a makeshift stage; it became one of Europe's key jazz and improv clubs until noise rules forced the move to the IJ. Status: gone (site redeveloped). Evidence: [Bimhuis history](https://www.bimhuis.nl/over-ons/geschiedenis); [Ons Amsterdam, Vaarwel Oudeschans!, 2005](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/vaarwel-oudeschans); [de Volkskrant, Het oude Bimhuis is nu al vergeten, 21 Feb 2005](https://www.volkskrant.nl/cultuur-media/het-oude-bimhuis-is-nu-al-vergeten~ba8a95f1/); [VVAB, Oudeschans 73-75-77](https://www.amsterdamsebinnenstad.nl/binnenstad/223/oudeschans.php). Caveats: check what stands at 73-77 now (VVAB article is about the replacement building); could also be handled as a "roots" note on the existing Bimhuis entry instead of a separate pin.

music-clubs.name: Akhnaton
music-clubs.line: 8. **Akhnaton** (Nieuwezijds Kolk 25; at the Kolk since 1971) (N): the Catholic students' society of 1953 that turned into the doorway for "new" music from far away: salsa, merengue, reggae, punk and, crucially, Dutch hip-hop (Osdorp Posse); still an independent venue. Status: open. Evidence: [Akhnaton, Historie](https://akhnaton.nl/geschiedenis-van-akhnaton/); [De Groene Amsterdammer, 1 Oct 1997](https://www.groene.nl/artikel/leven-in-gelul-aangejaagd-door-bewoners-die-in-gestalttherapie-en-sensitivity-training-de-beste-garanties-zagen-voor-geluk-eindigde-menige-vergadering-in-een-huilpartij); [en.wikipedia, Akhnaton (music venue)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akhnaton_(music_venue)). Caveats: Akhnaton's own site says the Oranje Vrijstaat (Kabouters, Feb 1970) was proclaimed "in Akhnaton"; that predates the 1971 move to the Kolk, so do not tie it to this building.

music-clubs.name: Fantasio, later Meditatiecentrum De Kosmos
music-clubs.line: 9. **Fantasio, later Meditatiecentrum De Kosmos** (Prins Hendrikkade 142; Fantasio 29 Mar 1968 to 1970, De Kosmos to its bankruptcy in 1992) (N): the third of the 1968 "cosmic" youth centres (with Paradiso and Melkweg), with music, a tea room and happenings; it became the country's main New Age centre. Status: gone (building in other use). Evidence: [Ons Amsterdam, Oosterse wijzen in De Kosmos](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/oosterse-wijzen-in-de-kosmos); [De Appel archive, Fantasio en Kosmos, 2015](https://www.deappel.nl/nl/archive/events/820-fantasio-en-kosmos); [Leiden University collection guide, De Kosmos](https://collectionguides.universiteitleiden.nl/agents/corporate_entities/248); [Vice NL 2017 (Hans Plomp)](https://www.vice.com/nl/article/de-grondleggers-van-het-amsterdamse-nachtleven-verblijven-al-decennialang-in-ruigoord/). Caveats: current use of no. 142 not checked; more a hippie legend than a music club, could sit in the squats slice.

music-clubs.name: Concerto
music-clubs.line: 11. **Concerto** (Utrechtsestraat 52-60; since 1955) (N): the city's institution record shop, a "second living room" for vinyl collectors for seventy years, with in-store gigs. Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool, Graaien en grijsdraaien: het verhaal van Concerto, 26 Nov 2021](https://www.parool.nl/ps/graaien-en-grijsdraaien-het-verhaal-van-concerto-meer-dan-een-platenzaak~b04f638d/); [Het Parool, Concerto viert verjaardag: al 65 jaar..., 10 May 2020](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/concerto-viert-verjaardag-al-65-jaar-de-vaste-stek-voor-amsterdamse-muziekfreaks~b480faf1/); [Het Parool, Gijs Molenaar: de man die Concerto groot maakte, 2009](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/gijs-molenaar-de-man-die-concerto-groot-maakte~b29cb679/). Caveats: more "beloved" than "underground"; Ewoud Kieft wrote its history.

music-clubs.name: De School
music-clubs.line: 14. **De School** (Dr. Jan van Breemenstraat 1; 2016 to Jan 2024) (N): 24-hour club, restaurant and gym in a former technical school in West, called "a nightclub of world level" when it closed after a marathon weekend; Tilla Tec took over the building. Status: changed (now Tilla Tec, itself reported closing Nov 2026, weak). Evidence: [Het Parool, Nachtclub De School sluit in januari 2024, 13 Jul 2023](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/nachtclub-de-school-sluit-in-januari-2024-definitief-de-deuren~bde0a69f/); [Het Parool, De Amsterdamse dancescene verliest met De School..., 12 Jan 2024](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/de-amsterdamse-dancescene-verliest-met-de-school-een-nachtclub-van-wereldniveau-die-vrijheid-zo-hoort-het-te-zijn-in-een-club~b8c2092f/); [Het Parool, Nieuwe nachtclub Tilla Tec komt in oude pand van De School, 11 Mar 2024](https://www.parool.nl/nederland/nieuwe-nachtclub-tilla-tec-komt-in-oude-pand-van-de-school-wij-gaan-het-gebouw-heel-anders-gebruiken~b7c3a4d2/). Caveats: 2022 criticism over door and safety (Parool 30 Jul 2022) belongs in the text for balance.

music-clubs.name: Radion
music-clubs.line: 15. **Radion** (Louwesweg 1; since 2014) (N; the building's art is E: "Graphic Surgery lines on the ACTA building", j12gzze1zr3g1lyevm0u3xu8): club and broedplaats in the former ACTA dentistry faculty, one of the first Amsterdam clubs with a 24-hour licence (2015). Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool, Radion krijgt 24-uursvergunning..., 11 Aug 2015](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/radion-krijgt-24-uursvergunning-en-trapt-af-met-36-uur-feest~b7cbdb92/); [NU.nl, Club Radion heeft 24-uursvergunning officieel binnen, 11 Aug 2015](https://www.nu.nl/amsterdam/4104517/club-radion-heeft-24-uursvergunning-officieel-binnen.html); [De Westkrant, 24 uur feesten in Radion, 2015](https://www.dewestkrant.nl/24-uur-feesten-in-radion/). Caveats: could merge with the ACTA art entry.

music-clubs.name: Club 11
music-clubs.line: 16. **Club 11** (Oosterdokskade 3-5, 11th floor of the Post CS building; 2005 to 28 Jun 2008) (N): temporary rooftop club in the empty post office tower (while the Stedelijk sat downstairs), the start of the "temporary club in an empty building" model that led to Trouw and De School. Status: gone. Evidence: [NRC, Nog elf dagen en dan stopt club 11, 19 Jun 2008](https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2008/06/19/nog-elf-dagen-en-dan-stopt-club-11-11558339-a1310811); [3voor12, Het boek 11 sluit met een boek, 21 May 2008](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/het-boek-11-sluit-met-een-boek); [Het Parool, Kaalslag dreigt voor undergroundclubs, 6 Aug 2022](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/kaalslag-dreigt-voor-undergroundclubs-we-moeten-redden-wat-er-te-redden-valt~b91bde17/). Caveats: RA says the building was "torn down in 2008"; the Post CS building was in fact kept and redeveloped. Verify before drafting.

music-clubs.name: Rush Hour
music-clubs.line: 17. **Rush Hour** (Spuistraat, since 1997) (N): record shop, distributor and label that began in a hairdresser's basement and became a world-known house and techno brand (Antal Heitlager). Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool, Platenzaak Rush Hour verhuist op de Spuistraat, 9 Feb 2016](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/platenzaak-rush-hour-verhuist-op-de-spuistraat~b4dbe9ef/); [Het Parool, Verdraaid lekker vinyl: 14 Amsterdamse platenzaken, 3 Sep 2024](https://www.parool.nl/uit-in-amsterdam/verdraaid-lekker-vinyl-14-amsterdamse-platenzaken-om-in-te-grasduinen~b3b2c41c7/); [Rush Hour, About](https://www.rushhour.nl/about-rush-hour-music). Caveats: house number after the 2016 move not confirmed (98 is the commonly given one).

music-clubs.name: Garage Noord
music-clubs.line: 19. **Garage Noord** (Gedempt Hamerkanaal 40; since Aug 2017) (N): bar and club in a former car repair shop that put local, queer-friendly and non-Western club music on the map; lease extended to about 2026 as the Hamerkwartier is built up. Status: open (threatened). Evidence: [RA, New club, Garage Noord, opens in Amsterdam, 22 Aug 2017](https://ra.co/news/39803); [Het Parool, Nachtclubs Garage Noord en Skatecafé blijven 3 jaar langer open, 5 Apr 2023](https://www.parool.nl/nederland/nachtclubs-garage-noord-en-skatecafe-blijven-3-jaar-langer-open-er-komen-leuke-dingen-aan~b50da95c/); [3voor12, Garage Noord opent nieuwe club in het centrum, 26 Oct 2022](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/garage-noord-opent-nieuwe-club-in-het-centrum-van-amsterdam). Caveats: young (2017); include as today's underground, not as a legend.

music-clubs.name: Bitterzoet
music-clubs.line: 21. **Bitterzoet** (Spuistraat 2; since 2003) (N): small club and stage that became the home of Amsterdam hip-hop and a breeding ground for new acts, in the former home of the Werkteater collective (from 1970). Status: open. Evidence: [AT5, Bitterzoet bestaat 10 jaar, 25 Sep 2013](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/111356/bitterzoet-bestaat-10-jaar); [Het Parool, Bitterzoet viert 10-jarig bestaan, 20 Sep 2013](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/bitterzoet-viert-10-jarig-bestaan~b4bef275/); [3voor12, Bitterzoet verkocht, 28 May 2008](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/bitterzoet-verkocht); [TheaterEncyclopedie, Bitterzoet Theater](https://theaterencyclopedie.nl/wiki/Bitterzoet_Theater,_Amsterdam). Caveats: none.

music-clubs.name: De Marktkantine
music-clubs.line: 23. **De Marktkantine** (Jan van Galenstraat 6; 2014 to 20 Jun 2022) (N; next to E "Centrale Markthal", tz8nsaab1ju8t1a9oo56hans): club in the former canteen of the central food market, closed for redevelopment despite a demonstration and petition. Status: gone. Evidence: [Het Parool, Nachtclub De Marktkantine sluit definitief in juni..., 21 Apr 2022](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/nachtclub-de-marktkantine-sluit-definitief-in-juni-ondanks-demonstratie-en-petitie~bfdaf527/); [Het Parool, demonstratie, 8 Apr 2022](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/demonstratie-tegen-vroegtijdige-sluiting-nachtclub-de-marktkantine-zonde-als-ze-gaan-slopen-en-dan-jaren-niets-gaan-doen~be83a87a/); [AD, 21 Apr 2022](https://www.ad.nl/amsterdam/nachtclub-de-marktkantine-sluit-definitief-in-juni-ondanks-demonstratie-en-petitie~afdaf527/). Caveats: whether the canteen is demolished yet not checked; mainstream-leaning programme, middling fit.

music-clubs.name: Zaal 100
music-clubs.line: 25. **Zaal 100** (De Wittenstraat 100; from the 1980s squat era) (N): small Staatsliedenbuurt stage "for unheard sound" (jazz, improv, jam sessions), named by Duivenvoorden as one of the squatters' theatre stages; hosted a 2018 Fantasio reunion. Status: open. Evidence: [Zaal 100, Over](https://zaal100.nl/over-zaal-100/); [Duivenvoorden full text](https://archive.org/stream/een-voet-tussen-de-deur-geschiedenis-kraakbeweging/Een-voet-tussen-de-deur-Geschiedenis-van-Eric-Duivenvoorden_djvu.txt); [Geheugen van West, Documentairefilm Staatsliedenbuurt / Zaal 100](https://geheugenvanwest.amsterdam/page/41020/documentairefilm-staatsliedenbuurt-zaal-100). Caveats: no news article found; founding year not found.

music-clubs.name: Winston Kingdom
music-clubs.line: 32. **Winston Kingdom** (Warmoesstraat 129; hotel bar from the mid-1980s, club since 2006) (N): bar of the art hotel Winston, hangout of painters, poets and musicians, later a small indie and rock club. Status: open. Evidence: [3voor12, Winston Kingdom tijdelijk gesloten voor verbouwing, 16 Sep 2008](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/3voor12amsterdam-winston-kingdom-tijdelijk-gesloten-voor-verbouwing); [3voor12, 22 Dec 2004](https://3voor12.vpro.nl/artikelen/3voor12amsterdam-bundelt-de-krachten-in-de-hoofdstad); [Podiuminfo, Winston](https://www.podiuminfo.nl/podium/193/Winston/Amsterdam/). Caveats: "mid-eighties hangout" rests on the venue's own blurb; middling.

music-clubs.name: De Nieuwe Anita
music-clubs.line: 33. **De Nieuwe Anita** (Frederik Hendrikstraat 111; since the mid-2000s) (N): living-room venue in a former neighbourhood café, film, gigs and the Huiskamerfestival; "one of the most unique places to go out" (Parool). Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool, 'In De Nieuwe Anita is het al vanaf 8 uur leuk', 15 Dec 2017](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/in-de-nieuwe-anita-is-het-al-vanaf-8-uur-leuk~b9e2c3b8/); [Het Parool, Crowdfunding voor cultureel café De Nieuwe Anita, 12 Feb 2021](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/crowdfunding-voor-cultureel-cafe-de-nieuwe-anita-echt-hartverwarmend~b742c5ca/); [Het Parool, Huiskamerfestival 20 jaar, 19 Aug 2025](https://www.parool.nl/ps/het-begon-20-jaar-geleden-houtje-touwtje-maar-het-huiskamerfestival-is-inmiddels-een-traditie-het-voelt-alsof-je-op-een-verjaardag-staat~b76752a4/). Caveats: founding year not confirmed.

music-clubs.name: Cinetol
music-clubs.line: 34. **Cinetol** (Tolstraat 182; since May 2014) (N; neighbour of E "Theosophical temple on the Tolstraat (Cinétol)", v7j8193dfwx0l45gdhesooqa): DIY-born small pop stage, about 250 gigs a year, part of the Vrije Ruimte network. Status: open. Evidence: [Cinetol, Over](https://www.cinetol.nl/over-cinetol); [Amsterdam Alternative, Vrije Ruimte Festival 2022](https://www.amsterdamalternative.nl/vrij-ruimte-festival/19773/vrije-ruimte-festival-2022); [nl.wikipedia, Tolstraat 160](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tolstraat_160). Caveats: the venue is in the 1980s building next door, not in the temple; no news source found.

music-clubs.name: Sexyland (World)
music-clubs.line: 35. **Sexyland (World)** (now NDSM Theater, NDSM-werf; since 2016 at the NDSM, Noordwal 2021, NDSM Theater 2026) (N): "cultuurhuis" run by 365 owners who each host one night a year. Status: open (new fixed home Aug 2026).
