Evidence: [Het Parool, Sexyland krijgt een vaste plek in Amsterdam, 28 Aug 2026](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/sexyland-krijgt-een-vaste-plek-in-amsterdam-het-voelt-als-thuiskomen~b5417312/); [Het Parool, Cultuurhuis Sexyland World verhuist tijdelijk..., 23 Apr 2021](https://www.parool.nl/kunst-media/cultuurhuis-sexyland-world-verhuist-tijdelijk-naar-voormalige-wilhelmina-dok~bbd60abf/); [Geschiedenislokaal (named among today's clubs)](https://geschiedenislokaalamsterdam.nl/bronnen/nachtclubs-in-amsterdam-van-de-jaren-80-tot-nu). Caveats: start year 2016 from memory, check.

music-clubs.name: Red Light Records (and Red Light Radio)
music-clubs.line: 36. **Red Light Records (and Red Light Radio)** (Oudezijds Achterburgwal 133 per its own page; Red Light Radio broadcast 2010-2020 from a former window brothel on the Oudekerksplein) (N): second-hand record shop since 2012 joined by the cult internet station that was "the shop window of the local music scene". Status: open (shop); radio stopped 2020. Evidence: [Het Parool, Red Light Radio stopt met het maken van radio, 8 May 2020](https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/red-light-radio-stopt-met-het-maken-van-radio~b1920d5c/); [Het Parool, Amsterdam verliest met Red Light Radio etalage van de lokale muziekscene, 26 Jun 2020](https://www.parool.nl/ps/amsterdam-verliest-met-red-light-radio-etalage-van-de-lokale-muziekscene~bda99572/); [RedlightRecords, official Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/redlightrecordsamsterdam/). Caveats: Parool 2024 lists the shop at Oudekerksplein 22 "in a former brothel", its own page at OZ Achterburgwal 133; resolve the address.

music-clubs.name: Studio 80
music-clubs.line: 37. **Studio 80** (Rembrandtplein; 2005 to Jan 2016, then Claire to 2019) (N): Duncan Stutterheim's small underground techno and minimal club, a launch pad for local DJs. Status: gone. Evidence: [AT5, 'Clubhuis' Studio 80 sluit deuren..., 2 Jan 2016](https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/151324/clubhuis_studio_80_sluit_deuren_na_laatste_avond_stampen); [NU.nl, Studio 80 sluit na tien jaar, 3 Jan 2016](https://www.nu.nl/amsterdam/4191844/studio-80-sluit-na-tien-jaar-definitief-haar-deuren.html); [nl.wikipedia, Studio 80](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_80). Caveats: exact house number not confirmed (often given as no. 17, the building of E "Café De Kroon", jb0kr9si85w15f4hekxxwq1u); ID&T roots make it less "alternative".

squats-freezones.name: Wyers
squats-freezones.line: 13. **Wyers** (Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal 5, head of the street; squatted 1981, evicted 14 Feb 1984) (N): the textile wholesaler's block that became the city's biggest squat complex ("Wyers wijkt niet"), cleared with riots for a Holiday Inn. Status: gone (now a Crowne Plaza hotel). Evidence: [Rijksmuseum: Ontruiming van het kraakpand Wijers (photos, 1984)](https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/nl/collectie/object/Ontruiming-van-het-kraakpand-Wijers--42bbb3526f17e03d1b01f55edfcbf1c0); [Ons Amsterdam: De twee werelden van Wyers](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/de-twee-werelden-van-wyers); [NOS Journaal 14 Feb 1984 (video)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC32XO6jz8Y). Caveats: gone place; it qualifies by impact (the eviction was the first one a mayor announced in advance, a turning point), but nothing on site tells the story. Could be drafted as a "(gone)" place like the Grote Wetering. Spelling varies: Wyers / Wijers.

squats-freezones.name: Kalenderpanden
squats-freezones.line: 15. **Kalenderpanden** (Entrepotdok 87-98; squatted Nov 1996 to 31 Oct 2000) (N; possible child of E "Entrepotdok, the bonded warehouses behind a wall", elt3qfrn5jv7jt44s2d9amcj): twelve warehouses named after the months, the last great squat bastion of the 1990s, with a public hall for concerts and theatre; its eviction came with raised bridges and barricades. Status: changed (luxury flats). Evidence: [Trouw 1 Nov 2000: Waren de Kalenderpanden het laatste krakersbolwerk?](https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/waren-de-kalenderpanden-het-laatste-krakersbolwerk~b6f7ec10/); [Digibron: Kalenderpanden in Amsterdam ontruimd](https://www.digibron.nl/viewer/collectie/Digibron); [squatters' own archive site](https://entrepotdok.squat.net/history.html); [Vrienden van de Amsterdamse Binnenstad: Op de bres LIII](https://www.amsterdamsebinnenstad.nl/). Caveats: the buildings stand; their month names are worth checking on the gables. The Trouw piece also names Vrieshuis Amerika and the Westerdoksdijk studios (see Borderline) and the 2000 start of the city's broedplaatsen policy.

squats-freezones.name: Mellow Yellow, the first coffeeshop
squats-freezones.line: 18. **Mellow Yellow, the first coffeeshop** (Weesperzijde 53, later Vijzelgracht; 1972/73-2017) (N): hippies squatted a bakery, turned it into a tea house in 1973 where hash was sold over the bar: the first coffeeshop. Fire in 1978 moved it to the Vijzelgracht; the school-distance rule closed it on 1 January 2017. Status: gone. Evidence: [Het Parool: Oudste coffeeshop slachtoffer van afstandscriterium](https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/oudste-coffeeshop-van-amsterdam-slachtoffer-van-afstandscriterium~bd6bce18/); [Andere Tijden: Oudste coffeeshop Mellow Yellow sluit deuren](https://anderetijden.nl/artikel/6658/Oudste-coffeeshop-Mellow-Yellow-sluit-deuren); [Ons Amsterdam: De eerste coffeeshop ter wereld](https://onsamsterdam.nl/artikelen/de-eerste-coffeeshop-ter-wereld). Caveats: gone at both addresses; qualifies on impact. Pin at Weesperzijde 53 (the squat, which is the story); what stands there now is unchecked. nl.wikipedia says founded 1972, the shop itself 1973.

squats-freezones.name: The Bulldog The First
squats-freezones.line: 19. **The Bulldog The First** (Oudezijds Voorburgwal 90; since 1975) (N): Henk de Vries's first coffeeshop in a basement under his family's sex cinema on the Wallen, the seed of the Bulldog chain and its hundreds of police raids. Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool, Geschiedenis van Amsterdam: the Leidseplein Bulldog and the Wallen shop before it](https://www.parool.nl/geschiedenis-van-amsterdam/in-het-pand-op-het-leidseplein-waar-de-politie-vroeger-kantoor-hield-opende-henk-the-bulldog-de-vries-zijn-coffeeshop-en-dat-was-geen-toeval~b48cf4e5/); [thebulldog.com: The First](https://thebulldog.com/locations/coffeeshops/the-bulldog-the-first/); [nl.wikipedia Mellow Yellow (Bulldog in 1975)](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mellow_Yellow_(coffeeshop)). Caveats: commercial, touristy today; "first" claims compete (Rusland also says 1975). Pair with item 20 or pick one.

squats-freezones.name: Gliphoeve
squats-freezones.line: 24. **Gliphoeve** (Bijlmer-Oost, now Geldershoofd and Gravestein; summer 1974) (N; possible child of E "Bijlmermeer", et0awp08hhog3xeyhfwv3crm): Surinamese activists under Just Maatrijk squatted nearly a hundred empty flats against the housing corporations' quotas: one of the first acts of Black activism in the Netherlands, and they won leases. Status: changed (renovated, renamed Geldershoofd and Gravestein). Evidence: [Volkskrant: Hoe een kraakactie de Bijlmer voorgoed veranderde](https://www.volkskrant.nl/kijkverder/2017/gliphoeve/); [VPRO: Gliphoeve, een vergeten strijd](https://www.vpro.nl/gliphoeve/artikelen/gliphoeve-een-vergeten-strijd); [Arcam: Gliphoeve](https://arcam.nl/architectuur-gids/gliphoeve/). Caveats: strongest Zuidoost item in this slice. The Bijlmermeer body already mentions it in one sentence.

squats-freezones.name: Joe's Garage
squats-freezones.line: 26. **Joe's Garage** (Pretoriusstraat 43; social centre since 2005) (N): a squatted, volunteer-run political social centre in the Transvaalbuurt: voku, give-away shop, the Oost squatting advice hour. It began in 2001 at Pretoriusstraat 28 and moved to no. 43, squatted in September 2005. Status: open. Evidence: [squat.net: 18 jaar Pretoriusstraat 43 en Joe's Garage](https://nl.squat.net/2023/09/13/amsterdam-18-jaar-pretoriusstraat-43-en-joes-garage-in-oost/); [Oost-online: Een monument in de Transvaalbuurt](https://oost-online.nl/een-monument-in-de-transvaalbuurt/); [joesgarage.nl](https://joesgarage.nl/). Caveats: no Parool/AT5 article found; the sources are a local paper and the movement's own. Dates differ (radar says open since June 2005, squat.net says no. 43 was squatted 25 Sept 2005): verify.

squats-freezones.name: Plantage Dok
squats-freezones.line: 28. **Plantage Dok** (Plantage Doklaan 8-12; squatted 1998, bought 2000) (N): a former church, printing works and craft school squatted by artists from the evicted Graansilo, bought with city help; studios, the Dokzaal and a gallery café. Status: open. Evidence: [Het Parool: Wandelen langs de kraakgeschiedenis van Amsterdam (2022)](https://www.parool.nl/ps/wandelen-langs-de-kraakgeschiedenis-van-amsterdam~bffb5ab1/); [Amsterdam op de kaart](https://amsterdamopdekaart.nl/1850-1940/Plantage_Doklaan/8-12); [plantagedok.nl history](https://plantagedok.nl/history/); [Nieuwe Instituut](https://nieuweinstituut.nl/projects/ontwerp-van-het-sociale/plantage-dok). Caveats: one of the eight founders of Amsterdam Alternative.
